evidence.quote: Flowchart of the patients included in the study. ESD, endoscopic submucosal dissection; C-ESD, conventional ESD; TA-ESD, traction-assisted ESD.
(A) A slightly elevated lesion was observed in the 12−3 o’clock quadrant of the pylorus.

(B) Retroflexion was impossible because of the narrow duodenal bulb. Therefore, mucosal marking and incision were performed around the tumor, excluding the distal portion, after indigo carmine chromoendoscopy.
(C) Submucosal dissection of the proximal portion was performed.
(D) After traction using an endoclip with dental floss, submucosal dissection and mucosal cutting of the distal portion were performed.
(E) The lesion was completely removed.
(F) Resected specimen.
